newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state offers stake in realty firm.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state offers stake in realty firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Housing, Tourism and Cinema on Tuesday offered investors a minimum 10 percent of its stake in partly-privatised Development and Engineering Consultancy, formerly known as Development and Popular Houses.
The firm said in a published advertisement that the public offer of at least 350,000 shares, of the firm's total 3.5 million shares, would be open for two days from April 22.
The offer price will be 32.92 pounds a share which is the stock's closing price on Monday.
Individuals should apply for at least 100 shares, while mutual funds and private firms have a 5,000 share minimum.
Banque Misr, Triple A Securities and Shorouq Brokerage are the agents for the sale.
The advertisement said the holding company is selling 10 percent of the 25.4 percent of its stake in the firm.
Private investors hold 19.9 percent of Development and Engineering Consultancy, public sector shareholders 44.7 percent and the firm's employee shareholder association holds the remaining 10 percent.
The holding firm sold its majority stake in Development and Engineering Consultancy in September.

The holding firm said the firm raised net after-tax profit to 12.046 million pounds in financial 1995/96 from 11.587 million in the previous year. It expects the profit to increase to 12.587 million in the current 1996/7 financial year.
The financial year ends on June 30.
The holding company said new shareholders would receive an expected dividend of 2.85 pounds at the end of the financial year 1996/97. The firm distributed 2.72 pounds in 1995/96.
Real estate firms are some of the most popular on the Cairo stock exchange and were behind the bourse's record highs earlier this year.
